class.name: OcgIntres2dIntersectionpoint
class.brief_description: Definition of an intersection point between two 2D curves.
class.description: ! Definition of an intersection point between two ! 2D curves.

method.name: from_2
method.description: Creates an IntersectionPoint. if ReversedFlag is False, the parameter Uc1(resp. Uc2) and the Transition Trans1 (resp. Trans2) refer to the first curve (resp. second curve) otherwise Uc1 and Trans1 (resp. Uc2 and Trans2) refer to the second curve (resp. the first curve).

method.name: SetValues
method.description: Sets the values for an existing intersection point. The meaning of the parameters are the same as for the Create.

method.name: Value
method.description: Returns the value of the coordinates of the intersection point in the 2D space.

method.name: ParamOnFirst
method.description: Returns the parameter on the first curve.

method.name: ParamOnSecond
method.description: Returns the parameter on the second curve.

method.name: TransitionOfFirst
method.description: Returns the transition of the 1st curve compared to the 2nd one.

method.name: TransitionOfSecond
method.description: returns the transition of the 2nd curve compared to the 1st one.
